name: Symfony Packages
description: Displays all installed Symfony packages with version information.
project_description:
Overview 

Symfony Packages provides a comprehensive dashboard for Drupal site administrators to monitor and manage all Symfony components used within their Drupal installation. The module creates a dedicated report page that displays detailed information about each Symfony package, including current versions, available updates, and package descriptions.

 Features 

 
 Symfony Package Inventory: Lists all installed Symfony components with their current versions 
 Update Status: Visual indicators show which packages have updates available 
 Version Information: Displays both the current and latest available versions for each package 
 Pre-release Detection: Shows pre-release version information when available 
 Package Descriptions: Pulls detailed descriptions from Packagist 
 Core vs Contrib Classification: Identifies which packages are required by Drupal core versus contributed modules 
 Filtering: Allows searching packages by name or description 
 Caching System: Implements performance-optimized caching for package data 
 Composer Integration: Uses Composer commands for accurate package information 
 Permission System: Integrates with Drupal's permission system for controlled access 
 
 For Site Builders 

Symfony Packages enables site administrators to maintain awareness of their site's dependency structure without requiring command-line access. The intuitive interface provides critical information at a glance with familiar Drupal admin theming.

 For Developers 

The module provides valuable insights into which Symfony components are used in your Drupal installation, helping developers avoid dependency conflicts and make informed decisions about package management.

 Requirements 

 
 Drupal 11 
 Composer-managed Drupal installation 
 
 This module is ideal for site administrators who want to maintain awareness of their site's Symfony dependencies and ensure they're running with the latest security updates.
